title: Panel: Graphite & Anode Supply, Processing and Market Dynamics
gist: Member-only video page for a 23-minute Benchmark Week 2026 panel on graphite and anode supply with Syrah Resources, BTR New Material Group and Benchmark's Head of Prices. It covered where anode technology is heading (silicon-carbon composites, hard carbon, lithium-metal) and how commercialisation timelines affect upstream raw material demand. No transcript or conclusions are given.

themes.theme: Next-generation anode technology and graphite demand

insights.claim: A Benchmark Week 2026 panel examined the direction of anode technology, including silicon-carbon composites, hard carbon and lithium-metal, and how their commercialisation timelines affect upstream raw material demand.
insights.speaker: Jacob Jonker, Executive General Manager – Commercial, Syrah Resources; Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mi
insights.so_what: When next-generation anodes commercialise determines how long conventional graphite demand runs, which matters for graphite miners and anode makers.
insights.quote: The direction of anode technology, including silicon-carbon composites, hard carbon and lithium-metal, and how commercialisation timelines affect upstream raw material demand.

insights.claim: The panel had Syrah Resources' Executive General Manager – Commercial Jacob Jonker, BTR New Material Group's Head of Solid-State Battery Department Chenglin Yang, and Benchmark Head of Prices Daisy Jennings-Gray. The page is member-only and states none of their views.
insights.speaker: Jacob Jonker, Executive General Manager – Commercial, Syrah Resources; Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mi
insights.so_what: The panel put an ex-China graphite producer (Syrah) next to a major Chinese anode maker (BTR) with a solid-state focus, but no positions are disclosed.

insights.claim: Benchmark's cathode market update at Benchmark Week 2026 covered cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional pricing arbitrage between them.
insights.speaker: Jacob Jonker, Executive General Manager – Commercial, Syrah Resources; Daisy Jennings-Gray, Head of Prices, Benchmark Mi
insights.so_what: Cathode capacity is spreading beyond China to Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, and regional price gaps create arbitrage that affects producer margins.
insights.quote: Cathode and precursor capacity growth across Korea, Morocco, Indonesia and Europe, regional pricing arbitrage, and which producers are leading global expansion.
